The '''rescue at the Imperial garbage scow''' took place when [[Saadoon-Kauldi]] released hundreds of slaves from this ship, during his [[Saadoon-Kauldi's anti-slaver campaign|anti-slaver campaign]].

==History==
At some point before [[10 BBY/Legends|10 BBY]], the [[Kadri'Ra]] up-and-comer [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]], and former [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] [[Saadoon-Kauldi]] decided to temporarily dedicate all his resources to release slaves from slaver ships. In his experience, released slaves swore loyalty to Saadoon-Kauldi, increasing his power and influence.

During this campaign, Saadoon-Kauldi attacked a [[Garbage scow/Legends|garbage scow]] affiliated to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and holding several hundreds of slaves, including an old, cultured [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronian]] by the name of [[Guzald]]. This attack was successful and the slaves were released; many of them, including Guzald, joined [[Saadoon-Kauldi's criminal empire]].
